mechanism: Tramadol lowers seizure threshold and moxifloxacin (fluoroquinolone) is associated with CNS effects including seizure risk, resulting in additive CNS toxicity; additional risk of QT prolongation with moxifloxacin.
action: Monitor closely for signs of seizures or CNS adverse effects; consider alternative fluoroquinolone with lower seizure risk or alternative analgesic if possible; assess QT interval baseline if patient has cardiac risk factors.
